title: SERV Act
committees: S-Small Business and Entrepreneurship Committee: Referred To 2025-02-25 || H-Small Business Committee: Referred To 2025-01-28
latest_action: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Small Business and Entrepreneurship.
summary: Successful Entrepreneurship for Reservists and Veterans Act or the SERV Act This bill requires (1) the Small Business Administration to report on the veterans interagency task force; and (2) the Government Accountability Office to report on access to credit for small businesses owned and controlled by veterans, Reservists, or their spouses.

journey.note: Passed the House; waiting on the Senate
